closedGates.requirement: Package graph publication must be atomic across real browser persistence: immutable content is published first, graph publication is based on an explicit persistent generation, stale-base writers are rejected, and PackageFS publication is fenced by the canonical persistent graph generation.

Cancellation, storage exhaustion and installer-worker death must never expose a half-installed PackageFS; verified immutable orphan content may remain, but graph publication requires a complete successful rerun.

dedicatedBrowserVerification.profile: declared Chrome / Ubuntu x64 CI profile

implementationHardening: SDK packagePersistence now opens both an OPFS content store and an OPFS package-graph store under Web Locks.
PackageGraphAuthority publishes persistent graphs from an explicit base generation and binds the in-memory graph to the resulting persistent generation/digest.
FrozenInstallAuthority requires the persistent generation lock for PackageFS publication and rejects stale persistent graph state.
Every install attempt arms the publication barrier before persistent-graph/preflight work; only a fully successful rerun clears it.
Persistent package graph CAS is retained in the repeated critical contract campaign.
